{{Quote|Look, I don't want any trouble.|The bartender|<ref name="APM" />}}
A '''bartender''' worked the late shift at [[Bar Jaraniz]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], a shift which lasted from some point in the evening until dawn. A [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual, the [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] was versed in the creation of [[Jaraniz cocktail|elaborate cocktails]], and possessed a cautious demeanor.<ref name="APM" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], the bartender crafted a [[Vosh/Legends|vosh]] cocktail with [[geref]] chunks, [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] segments, and skewers for a patron of Bar Jaraniz. While doing so, he temporarily stopped to speak with the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Goran Beviin]], serving him two bottles of [[Ale/Legends|ale]] and directing the man toward a [[Nom Anor|prospective client]] that had been waiting at the tapcaf.<ref name="APM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bar Jaraniz's unnamed bartender was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the [[New Jedi Order era]] [[EBook|e-novella]] entitled ''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]'', written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published in [[August]], [[2006]].<ref name="APM" />
